# Jordi Jaspers — Lead Software & Applied AI Engineer

Canonical URL: https://jordijaspers.dev
Employer: Ilionx (https://www.ilionx.com/)
Location: Maastricht, Netherlands
Email: jordijaspers@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/Jordi-Jaspers
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jordi-jaspers/
Resume: https://jordijaspers.dev/files/resume.pdf

Jordi Jaspers is a Lead Software & Applied AI Engineer and Consulting Manager at Ilionx,
based in Maastricht, Netherlands. He leads a team of 15+ engineers, building enterprise-grade
distributed systems and applied AI solutions. With 7+ years of professional experience and
2+ years specializing in AI/ML, he has delivered 30+ projects and 20+ enterprise solutions
for major clients including VodafoneZiggo, APG, and TenneT.

---

## Experience / Career

**Lead Software & Applied AI Engineer / Consulting Manager** — Ilionx (2024–Present)
- Leading a team of 15+ engineers across multiple enterprise engagements
- Architecting and delivering AI/ML solutions including LLM gateways and RAG pipelines
- Consulting manager responsible for team growth, client relations, and delivery

**Medior Software Engineer** — Ilionx (2021–2024)
- Delivered 20+ enterprise solutions for clients in telecom, finance, and energy sectors
- Specialized in distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architectures

**Junior Software Engineer** — Ilionx (2018–2021)
- Started career at Ilionx while completing MSc degree
- Contributed to backend services and internal tooling

**Notable Clients:** VodafoneZiggo, APG, TenneT

## Projects

**JFrame** — Open-source Java/Spring/Quarkus utility library (Apache 2.0).
Provides reusable components for enterprise Java applications.
https://github.com/JFrameOSS/JFrame

**Eventify** — Real-time service monitoring and alerting platform.
Built with Spring Boot, SvelteKit, and TimescaleDB. Supports multi-team dashboards.
https://github.com/Jordi-Jaspers/Eventify | Live: https://eventify-tst.jordijaspers.dev/

**Aniflix** — Anime streaming platform (archived).
Full-stack application with Spring Boot backend and modern frontend.
https://github.com/Jordi-Jaspers/Aniflix | https://aniflix.stream/

**AI Relay** — Enterprise AI gateway for secure, governed LLM access (NDA · Ilionx).
Enables organizations to use LLMs with audit logging, rate limiting, and policy enforcement.

**KirchroaGPT** — Regional dialect large language model for local government (NDA).
Fine-tuned LLM that understands and generates text in the Kirchroa (Kerkrade) dialect.

**Multi-Agent Dev Platform** — Internal AI-assisted engineering platform (Ilionx).
Achieves 5–10× productivity gains through multi-agent orchestration for software development.
